research.title: Boundary-Aware Consistency for Segmentation Under Motion Blur
bullets: Formulated whether separating boundary and interior consistency losses could preserve object contours when semantic segmentation models encounter motion blur.
Led development of a boundary-weighted training objective and evaluated contour accuracy through controlled blur perturbations and loss ablations.

research.title: Region-Consistent Semantic Segmentation Under Illumination Shifts
bullets: Formulated how illumination changes affect regional prediction consistency and led development of a segmentation objective aligning predictions across photometric transformations.
Extended the objective with confidence-filtered regional supervision and designed evaluations separating illumination robustness, calibration, and sensitivity to region construction.

Evaluating Illumination Robustness and Calibration in Region-Consistent Semantic Segmentation
Region-Level Prediction Consistency for Semantic Segmentation Under Photometric Transformations

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Local Feature Matching
bullets: Implemented image matching pipelines using gradient-based descriptors and binary descriptors, with geometric verification through robust homography estimation.
Compared matching reliability under viewpoint changes, compression, and illumination variation, examining correspondence errors and sensitivity to descriptor matching thresholds.

projects.title: Transfer Learning for Fine-Grained Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen-feature and partial fine-tuning baselines for fine-grained image classification using pretrained convolutional networks and consistent preprocessing.
Compared classwise errors and training behavior across adaptation strategies, controlling data partitions and inspecting confusions between visually similar categories.

projects.title: Classical and Convolutional Approaches to Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented bilateral filtering, nonlocal means, and a residual convolutional denoiser for images corrupted with synthetic additive noise.
Evaluated reconstruction quality across noise conditions using perceptual similarity and pixel error, inspecting texture loss and edge preservation.

projects.title: Optical Flow Comparison for Short Video Sequences
bullets: Implemented pyramidal local flow estimation and a variational optical flow baseline with shared frame preprocessing and visualization routines.
Compared motion estimates against reference flow fields, analyzing endpoint errors near occlusions, low-texture regions, and large object displacements.
